title: Polar H10 HRV Session Weekly Session Length Trend
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=polar:hrv duration_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(duration_min) as avg_duration, max(duration_min) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst session length for Polar H10 HRV session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture duration_min on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average session length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It times whether Polar H10 HRV session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
